about.title: 📖 About this project
about.description: This database compiles public information about US military and political interventions abroad from 1775 to present. Data comes from Wikipedia articles and other verifiable sources.
about.purpose: Educational purpose: To facilitate understanding of the historical context of international relations. This project does not promote any political position; information is presented neutrally for educational purposes.
about.methodology: Methodology: Data was extracted from Wikipedia (ES/EN) and structured in bilingual JSON format. Each record includes start/end year, country, description and link to original source for verification.
